what: SPEC §5.5 calls for event uplights to wash the white N-block wall of the supercar recess (3000 K) at dusk and night. Nothing lights that wall: at 20:00 it is a dim, uniform beige (only the night ambient) next to the brightly spot-lit cars, so the recess display reads unfinished.
where: campus:arrival and biocity:entrance at Fri 16:45–Sat 01:00; desktop high and ultra. <scratch>/tod-r1/shots/s1/campus-arrival_062000.png, .../shots/ultra/campus-arrival_062000.png, .../shots/m-s5.png (BCentr row)
fix: Add 3–4 floor-mounted wall-washers along the NE recess wall: 3000 K, an emissive lens, and a painted gradient or projected wash on the wall that fades over about 8–10 m. Switch them on at sunset with the other event lights.

what: In 'Eye level' tours (a UI option) a large rhombus sits in the lower part of every frame. It belongs to the routes module: it disappears only when routes is hidden. It is lit by the scene, so it is white by day and a black hole at night.
where: Eye-level tours partners-tykistokatu-to-stands t 0.35 and 0.70, partners-fri-train-edu t 0.90 and 0.97, companies-tykistokatu-to-showroom t 0.60 and 0.90, at Sat 11:00 and Fri 20:00; desktop high. <scratch>/tod-r1/shots/m-rh.png (as-is / routes, people and event hidden / routes shown again), .../shots/m-tf.png
fix: In first-person mode, hide the walker pin or arrow within about 2 m of the camera, or place it at least 4 m ahead on the floor. Make route markers emissive in the event violet so they never turn black at night.
